Investiamo molto anche nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Offriamo anche sconti interessanti su marchi rinomati come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a committed and service-oriented personality for our Aarau outpatient clinic as of September 1, 2026 or by appointment as tasks:
• You receive patients and operate the telephone
• You write medical-psychiatric reports as well as general correspondence via Dictaphone
• You record, control and maintain patient and billing data as well as organize and coordinate appointments after written registration
• You manage the electronic medical records in the HIS/Orbis
• You take on general administrative and organizational tasks Secretarial tasks Requirements:
• Commercial training with experience in a comparable function, ideally in a medical environment; Further training to become a medical secretary is an advantage
• Confident German and enjoy writing reports
• Enjoying patient contact and a strong service orientation
• Reliable, precise and independent way of working as well as the ability to work in a team and resilience
• High IT affinity We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. That's exactly why we offer you a lot: we strongly encourage further training. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all of our teams access to the “Moodtalk” software, which strengthens team communication. We also offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.
